title: Rolle for a shifted quadratic · Set 3
statement:
Find the Rolle point for $(x-[$a])^2$ on $[[$a]-1,[$a]+1]$.

[__________]{a}
hints: Set the derivative equal to zero.
solution: Both endpoint values are 1. Solve $2(c-[$a])=0$, giving $c=[$a]$.

feedback.message: Set the derivative equal to zero.
